rules.TIME_OUT_OF_PERIOD: Pickup timestamp outside the months being loaded
rules.TIME_NON_POSITIVE: Dropoff is at or before pickup
rules.DISTANCE_ZERO: Trip distance is zero or negative
rules.NEGATIVE_COMPONENT: A fee, tip, toll or surcharge is negative
rules.TOTAL_MISMATCH: Total differs from the sum of its components by more than $5
rules.INVALID_VENDOR: VendorID not in the TLC data dictionary
rules.DUPLICATE_TRIP: Same vendor, timestamps, zones, distance and fare as an earlier row
rules.TIP_EXCEEDS_FARE: kept: tip larger than the fare (generous or mistyped)
rules.CRAWL_SPEED: kept: under 2 mph for over 30 minutes (gridlock or meter left on)
rules.TOTAL_UNEXPLAINED_FEE: kept: total is $1-5 above its components (unlisted surcharge)
rules.UNKNOWN_ZONE: kept: pickup or dropoff zone is 264 Unknown / 265 Outside NYC
rules.NEGOTIATED_SHORT: kept: negotiated fare over $50 for under a mile
